description: This Java source file defines the 'InternalSelectionView' class, a custom Android View component that manages a list of selectable rows. It handles rendering multiple rows, managing selection state, focus behavior, and drawing visual indicators for current selection. It provides horizontal and vertical measurement, drawing logic, keyboard navigation, and focus change handling for internal selection highlighting.

classes.name: InternalSelectionView
classes.description: A custom Android View that displays a specified number of selectable rows, manages internal selection, handles focus changes, drawing, and keyboard navigation.
